sender.en: A social media ad with a famous person or a broker’s name, then a WhatsApp “investment group”

name.en: Fake investment app: “guaranteed daily profit”, until you try to withdraw

how.en: Ads on social media, sometimes AI-made with pictures of well-known people or real brokers, promise high, risk-free returns on stocks or other products. You are added to a WhatsApp group and sent to an app or website that shows a dashboard with growing profits. Small early withdrawals work, so you invest more; when you ask for your money back, the platform blocks you. The SECP has declared several such platforms illegal.

text.en: An ad promises high, guaranteed returns, often with a celebrity.
You are moved to a WhatsApp group and an unlicensed app.
The dashboard shows profits and a small withdrawal works.
You are pushed to invest more, then blocked when you withdraw.
Join our VIP stock strategy group, guaranteed 3% daily profit. Our analysts are from a top brokerage. Start with only Rs 10,000: [link]
Your account profit is Rs 4,85,000. To withdraw, first pay 15% tax and verification fee to the platform account.

en: investment app shows profit but no withdrawal
platform blocked account after withdrawal request
pay tax to withdraw profit investment app
unlicensed online trading app secp warning
Investing through a WhatsApp group or an app not licensed by the SECP or listed brokers.
Fees or “tax” before you can withdraw.
Invest only through SECP-licensed firms and brokers listed by PSX or PMEX.
Never pay a fee to withdraw your own money.
Report to NCCIA on 1799 and tell your bank.

sources.title: SECP warns public against illegal online investment platforms
SECP flags illegal trading app using broker names and celebrity images to lure investors
